start: Profile tab, member with 12 workouts and a first record

steps.action: Tap the badge shelf on Profile
user_sees: 'You earn badges from the workouts you log in the app. Each badge is earned once, on the day of the workout that earned it.'
must_not: A count other than 16 badges in all

user_sees: Earned badges newest first, each with 'Earned <date>' (for example 'First workout', '10 workouts', 'First record')
must_not: A badge dated on a day with no workout

user_sees: Each locked badge with how to earn it and how far along, for example 'Finish 50 workouts.' and '12 of 50 workouts'
must_not: A locked badge with no way to earn it written

start: Active workout that starts at 6:10 am, the 5th early start

user_sees: The finish screen line 'New badge: Early bird'
must_not: Workout-count badges repeated in that line
The badge given again on a later early workout

start: New member with no workouts and no body weight logged

user_sees: Only 'Still to earn', every badge with its how-to and no progress line
must_not: An 'Earned' heading with nothing under it
'0 of 50 workouts' style lines for every badge

user_sees: 'Bench press your own body weight or more on a barbell. Log your body weight on your Profile, under Body, so the app can check.'
must_not: The badge given without a body weight to compare

steps.action: Open Badges when the workouts cannot be read
user_sees: A load error for 'your badges' with a retry

start: Badges page, '10 workouts' earned on 9 Oct

steps.action: Delete a workout so only 9 are left, open Badges
user_sees: '10 workouts' back under 'Still to earn' with '9 of 10 workouts'
must_not: A badge left behind for a workout that no longer exists

steps.action: Miss a week after a 5-week run, open Badges
user_sees: '4 weeks in a row' still earned; '12 weeks in a row' says 'Your longest run so far: 5 weeks'
must_not: An earned badge taken away by a broken run

start: Badges page, member who logs body weight

steps.action: Open 'Bench your body weight' locked and earned
user_sees: Only earned or the how-to: no number and no progress
must_not: The member's body weight or a progress figure that gives it away
